remarks: Welcome to this versatile beautifully maintained Single-family home, ideally located in the heart of Stamford, Springdale neighborhood.   This inviting property features a spacious main residence with 3 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, a kitchen, a living room, and a dining room offering bright living spaces, hardwood floors, and stainless still appliances in the kitchen.  what makes this home special is the separate in-law apartment, perfect for extended family or guests with its own private entrance. Situated on a well-sized lot with a charming backyard, ample parking, a detached 2-car garage, and easy access to shopping, dining, schools, and the Springdale train station. This property offers convenience and opportunity in one of Stamford's most welcoming communities. Don't miss the opportunity to make this beautiful house yours!
